item.title: Hazy skies over the Valley: Here’s what to know
item.description: HARLINGEN, Texas (ValleyCentral) — You may have noticed hazier than usual conditions across the Valley today and a temperature inversion is to blame. So, what is a temperature inversion? Under normal conditions, the air gets cooler as you go higher in the atmosphere. That temperature drop allows warm air near the ground to rise and mix out.
